name: Vann
source:
Affiliation: Gregorian (SOG - retired)
Location: Gregorian Cluster
Relationship: Bro / Wingman
Personnel File: Vann used to serve in the Gregorian military, but that service is shrouded in secrecy. Less secret is his care for [url=/c136749]Noella Hughes[/url] and her family.
Strengths: Kind, Funny, Streetwise, Veteran, Hand to hand combat, Loyal to a fault.
Weaknesses: Mild PTSD, not hugely intelligent, difficulty taking initiative, alcoholic.
Note in File: Gregorian Intelligence would love to re-establish a working relationship with Vann. Hopefully his contact with the [url=/c136741]Captain of the Agni[/url] will spark something in him.
